# Inventory fixtures (feature 017)

A miniature repository for `zoo data stats|history|diff`: two topics, two datasets (one rejected),
a source register, a CAN-style benchmark in two versions (`cap-v2` is `based_on` `cap-v1`), a JTBD
pilot and cluster manifest, a span training set and one release record. `data/` stands in for
`$MMZ_DATA`. Every file is synthetic and tiny; nothing here is real data.
